behaviour.R1: Before its first edit to the implementation file(s) it changes, the agent opens and reads the content of every implementation file it changes.
behaviour.R2: Before its first edit to the implementation, the agent opens and reads the content of the files that import (call) the changed function or symbol: at least five such caller files, or all of them if there are fewer.
behaviour.R3: Before its first edit to the implementation, the agent runs a search over the source files (grep, rg, git grep, or find by name).
behaviour.R4: Before its first edit to the implementation, the agent runs git log, git blame or git show to check the history of the code it changes.
behaviour.R5: Before making any implementation edit, the agent runs a test related to the change (or a reproduction script) and observes it FAIL, in a separate, earlier tool call (it observes the failure first).
behaviour.W1: The agent writes or edits a test file BEFORE it first edits the implementation file.
behaviour.W2: The agent runs a test it newly wrote and sees it FAIL on a source tree that does not yet contain the implementation change, in a tool call before the implementation edit.
behaviour.E1: After its LAST source edit, the agent runs the tests that cover the changed implementation file(s) on that final tree, and all of them pass.
behaviour.E2: After its LAST source edit, the agent runs the linter (biome check or eslint) over all the changed source files on that final tree, and it exits with code 0.

context: An AI coding agent fixes a bug in a TypeScript repository (unit tests with vitest, lint with biome). The texts quoted are written in Japanese.
